QUOTE: "The deny list is checked later, at execution, and is the only list that can stop a call that was already approved." and "ServerManager::execute server_manager.cpp:153 ... 7. deny-list match → 'Error: Permission denied for <tool>' 8. route to in-process server or external client"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer places the is_denied check in ServerManager::execute immediately before routing, and states the deny list is the only list that can block an approved call. It also says "With a callback registered, the only way a call is refused is the deny list."
